The '''brother''' of [[The Claw (bounty hunter)|the Claw]] was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who was framed for legal difficulties involving a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. While in prison, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an altercation; his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] brother hunted those he believed were responsible.<ref name="Under The Claw" />
